reviews.text: I went to see Dave to see if he could do a drive shaft replacement for me and he said that he had time to do it then, took him less than an hour and for way cheaper than another quote I got. Very knowledgeable and competent mechanic that knew exactly what to do. I would highly recommend him doing the repairs and I will be going back to him to do the other side. Thanks Dave for your excellent service.
